text:
We have reviewed your complaint and have recorded the concern regarding Nala’s travel experience with Aurelia Skyways.

You reported that communication and the handling of your pet’s situation in transit did not meet your expectations, and that the follow-up process felt unclear when you needed support.

For escape in transit, you must file your claim within 59 days. Please keep in mind that meeting this filing window is essential for the desk to be able to review the matter thoroughly and to coordinate any next steps.

When a passenger contacts the companion animal travel desk, the welcome team prepares for boarding and the senior coordinators aim to keep interactions respectful and prompt. In the event of an unexpected incident, the supervisor on duty listens carefully to the travel details provided by the passenger, and we ensure that the information is logged in the customer record so the review can proceed. If there was a pause or a gap in messaging in your case, we understand how stressful that can feel, and we want to acknowledge that concern.

To help us finalize the record, please ensure any confirmation references you received are included with your submission, along with a clear summary of what you observed and when. If you have already sent materials, the desk will match them to your booking record and confirm what is still needed. Where possible, we also compare the timeline against our operational notes so we can identify where communication may have fallen short.

Thank you for sharing these details, and we appreciate the opportunity to address your complaint. Companion Animal Travel Desk
